:::{#thm-p-subset-np}
#### P is contained in NP

Every decision problem in P (@def-class-p) is in NP (@def-class-np).

:::

::: {.proof}

Let an algorithm $A$ decide $L$ in polynomial time.
Take $q(n) = 0$, so the only certificate is the empty string,
and let the verifier $V(x, u)$ ignore $u$ and return $A(x)$.
$V$ runs in polynomial time,
and $V(x, u) = 1$ exactly when $x \in L$.

:::
